newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Emvasa upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Emvasa upgraded to buy.

text.p: Valores Finamex said Thursday it upgraded its recommendation on Mexican bottler Emvasa to buy from speculative buy.
-- Said upgrade due to three factors:
-- "The 1997 Q1 increase in sales volume, which was above our expectations,
-- "The substantial improvement in the operating margin and cash flow,
-- "The stronger management team, with a new operations director."
-- Emvasa's first quarter sales volume was 15.5 million unit cases, up by 1.2 percent from Q1 1996.
--- "This is the first time Emvasa has posted an increase in sales volume since 1995," Valores said.
